story.title: Ramayana advance bookings to open on Dussehra ahead of November 5 theatrical release
story.summary: Advance bookings for Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi, will open across India on October 20, coinciding with Dussehra. The film, directed by Nitesh Tiwari, is scheduled to release in theatres worldwide on November 5, 2026.According to the makers, audiences will be able to book tickets through major ticketing platforms and choose from premium theatrical formats, including IMAX

story.title: FIRST LOOK at Hanuman in 'Ramayana' spin-off revealed! - WATCH
story.summary: Sunny Deol's first look as Lord Hanuman was revealed at an event in Hyderabad for the film 'Ramayana'. The producers announced plans for multiple spin-off projects based on various characters from the epic saga. Advance bookings for the film are set to begin during the festival of Dussehra in India. The first part of 'Ramayana' is scheduled for release on November 5, 2026.
